zoe_marketing: FYI — SDRs flagged several international leads routed to the wrong queue this morning (EMEA -> APAC) during the 08:40 spike.
lee_revops: I see the pattern: enrichment webhook arrives ~400ms after create and our router assigns on create. Happens more under burst.
carl_eng: Quick fix idea: add a 600ms router debounce for contacts created via webform + mark inferred_country=true when we fallback.
nora_sdrlead: 600ms fine. SDRs prefer accuracy. Please add a visible tag for inferred.
lee_revops: Plan: 1) feature flag router.debounce_ms=600 for source=form; 2) HS workflow to set assignment_ready=false until enrichment completes (wf id wf_2024x); 3) add metric lead.inferred_flag_rate.
carl_eng: Pushed small canary behind flag, will run 5% traffic for 30m. Pseudocode: `if (!props.country && source==='form') wait(debounce_ms) else assign()`
hs-bot: hubspot-bot: Workflow inbound-enrich updated: set assignment_ready=true after enrichment (wf id wf_2024x).
lee_revops: Canary started. If overflow_pool > 30 in 10m or inferred_flag_rate > 5% rollback.
zoe_marketing: Notifying SDR leads and CRM-ops, will post follow-up after 1h. nora_sdrlead: Seeing fewer misroutes so far, will monitor.
zoe_marketing: Closing thread after 24h stable.
